prompt: Create an artisanal storefront for Komorebi Ceramic & Tea Studio using evals/fixtures/visual-quality/ecommerce-brief.json. Deliver 4 pages (Home, Shop Catalogue, Product Detail, About Craft). Emphasize tactile sensory aesthetics, wabi-sabi earth tones, spacious product presentation, and complete avoidance of cheap high-urgency ecommerce tropes.
expected_outcomes: Storefront and Product Detail present calm, spacious compositions reflecting craft provenance
High-detail macro imagery of ceramic glaze crazing and wood-firing kiln textures
Sticky add-to-tote and decision spec table are refined and legible on mobile viewports
Zero high-urgency neon countdown timers or discount popup modals
Deterministic visual gates pass with no horizontal overflow and valid viewport meta
must_not: Use flashing discount banners, urgency timers, or neon badge spam
Produce generic 3-column card layouts for both catalogue and product detail views
Render low-contrast text on tactile background patterns
Use low-resolution or watermarked stock tea imagery
